description: What makes Bradford, Fairlee, and West Fairlee special isn't just our beautiful scenery, historic buildings, or local businesses? It's the people who call these towns home.The Community Bingo Challenge was created to encourage neighbors, families, friends, and community groups to get out, explore, and reconnect with one another. In a time when many of us are busier than ever, this challenge provides a fun and simple way to discover local landmarks, support small businesses, meet new people, and
title: Community Bingo Challenge: "Explore Local"
